title: Sovereign Crownmark System - Godot 4 Architecture Plan

sections.title: 1. Autoloads (Singletons)
sections.subtitle: Global Managers & Lifecycle Coordinators
sections.description: Establish standard Godot 4 singletons in project settings. These nodes persist in the root viewport, serving as server-authoritative coordinators for data structures, inventory changes, and global game state signaling.
sections.gdscript:

sections.title: 4. Crownmark Manager
sections.subtitle: Socket Mapping & Equipment Constraints
sections.description: Coordinates the 8-slot visual mapping for each individual commander. Ensures active crownmarks are equipped to legal slots and coordinates state events when equipment configurations shift.
sections.gdscript:
# classes/crownmark_manager.gd
class_name CrownmarkManager
extends RefCounted

# Slot Types: "weapon", "crown", "armor", "banner", "accessory", "ring", "goggles", "crucible"
const NUM_SLOTS = 8

# Maps slot index (0..7) to equipped crownmark UUID in inventory
var equipped_slots: Array = [
    "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""
]

var owner_hero_id: String = ""

func _init(hero_id: String) -> void:
    owner_hero_id = hero_id

func get_equipped_crownmarks_list(inventory: CrownmarkInventory) -> Array:
    var list = []
    for uuid in equipped_slots:
        if uuid != "" and inventory.items.has(uuid):
            list.append(inventory.items[uuid])
    return list

sections.title: 5. Save System (Anti-Cheat Security)
sections.subtitle: Encrypted Client State Persistence
sections.description: Reads and writes local inventory configurations. Employs a secure Godot 4 FileAccess encryption key (`FileAccess.open_encrypted_with_pass`) to mitigate hex editing and local client manipulation of rare legendary metrics.

sections.title: 6. Equip Logic & Slot Validation
sections.subtitle: Enforcing Rarity, Affinity, and Cap Bounds
sections.description: Checks and executes standard item swaps. Verifies whether the crownmark matches the specified commander's slot constraints and sets up standard events for UI elements.
sections.gdscript:
# services/crownmark_equip_service.gd
class_name CrownmarkEquipService
extends RefCounted

static func equip_crownmark(
    hero_id: String,
    crownmark_uuid: String,
    slot_idx: int,
    inventory: CrownmarkInventory,
    hero_equipments: Dictionary
) -> bool:
    if not inventory.items.has(crownmark_uuid):
        return false
        
    var crownmark_inst = inventory.items[crownmark_uuid]
    var template_id = crownmark_inst["crownmark_id"]
    var template = CrownmarkDataManager.get_crownmark_template(template_id)
    
    # Validation: Affinity Guard
    var affinity = template.get("hero_affinity", "")
    if affinity != "" and affinity != hero_id:
        print("[EQUIP_REJECTED] Incompatible hero affinity: ", affinity)
        return false
        
    # Validation: Ensure hero slot mapping container exists
    if not hero_equipments.has(hero_id):
        hero_equipments[hero_id] = ["", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""]
        
    var active_slots: Array = hero_equipments[hero_id]
    
    # Unbind previously bound crownmark in this physical slot
    var old_crownmark_uuid = active_slots[slot_idx]
    if old_crownmark_uuid != "":
        inventory.items[old_crownmark_uuid]["equipped_hero"] = ""
        
    # Strip this crownmark from other heroes if previously equipped
    var prev_hero = crownmark_inst["equipped_hero"]
    if prev_hero != "" and hero_equipments.has(prev_hero):
        var prev_slots: Array = hero_equipments[prev_hero]
        var old_idx = prev_slots.find(crownmark_uuid)
        if old_idx != -1:
            prev_slots[old_idx] = ""
            
    # Bind new crownmark
    active_slots[slot_idx] = crownmark_uuid
    crownmark_inst["equipped_hero"] = hero_id
    
    CrownmarkGlobals.crownmark_equipped.emit(hero_id, crownmark_uuid, template.get("slot", "generic"))
    CrownmarkGlobals.inventory_updated.emit()
    return true

sections.gdscript:
# shaders/crownmark_auras.gd
extends Node
# Assigns dynamic shader values depending on active set milestone tier levels

static func update_shader_uniforms(sprite_node: Sprite2D, resonance_tier: int, aura_color: Color) -> void:
    var material = sprite_node.material as ShaderMaterial
    if not material:
        return
        
    # Update uniforms dynamically
    material.set_shader_parameter("tier_threshold", float(resonance_tier))
    material.set_shader_parameter("glow_intensity", 1.2 if resonance_tier >= 3 else 0.4)
    material.set_shader_parameter("spectral_tint", aura_color)

sections.title: 18. Performance & Optimization
sections.subtitle: Server-Authoritative Safe Frame Rendering
sections.description: Details precise performance targets (60 FPS garbage collection mitigation, pooled VFX particles, debounced sorting routines, and lazy-loaded nodes).
sections.gdscript:
# performance_optimization_targets.txt
# Core optimization recommendations:
# 1. Thread-safe asset loader: Use 'ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request()' for dynamic visual icons
# 2. Debouncing Search Inputs: Connect search filters to a Timer node of 150ms before triggering array filtering
# 3. Particle Pooler: Recycle glowing 'CPUParticles2D' nodes instead of continuous queue_free and instantiate operations
# 4. Lazy-loading Tab Pages: Avoid instantiating codex and upgrade panels until their active buttons are selected
